items: **"A Livable Future"** report: heat exposure cost India ~247 billion labour hours and $194 billion in potential income (2024); agriculture = 66% of lost hours; India = $1.6 trillion sustainable-cooling investment opportunity by 2040

**World Development Report 2026 — "The Promise of AI"**: only 4.5% of jobs in LMICs at automation risk (vs 14.2% high-income); AI could raise productivity in 16.2% of developing-country jobs (vs 18.7% high-income); India: AI weather forecasts saved Telangana farmers up to $560 each

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — $194 bn income loss + 247 bn labour hours; 4.5% vs 14.2% automation-risk pair — genuine confusion trap vs the 16.2%/18.7% productivity-gain figures.
